title: Hollis's Postcards

rewards.text: A memorial in the Corwin lobby; Odessa +1 per five cards; the last card unlocks Hollis's radio station preset

where: Pawnshops, fences, the Corwin, Earl's stand, the Royal (20 hidden across the core)
mobile: Cards glint at close range; an 'ask around' prompt points to the right block.
